name: io.github.shunyagatha/vecline
description: Local-first image, vector and document toolkit that measures its own output. Nothing uploaded.

packageArguments.description: Starts the MCP server. `vecline` is a full toolkit; `mcp` is the subcommand that speaks JSON-RPC over stdio.

environmentVariables.name: VECLINE_SOFFICE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Path to a LibreOffice `soffice` binary, used only by the Office conversion tools. Left unset, they are auto-detected; if LibreOffice is absent the affected tools report themselves as unavailable rather than failing.
